If you’re short on time, antagonist paired sets can help you make your workouts more efficient without unnecessarily sacrificing training volume.

The concept is simple. Instead of completing all your sets of one exercise before moving to another, alternate between exercises targeting opposing muscle groups.

For example, pair bench presses with rows, or bicep curls with tricep extensions.

While one muscle group is working, the other gets some recovery time.
